# set random number seed
```{r}
# Set random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)
```

# set sample size and trial number of each sub
```{r}
# Simulation parameters
N <- 50    # Number of subjects
T_max <- 48    # Number of trials per subject
```

# set true parameters
## True group-level parameters
```{r}
mu_alpha <- 0.6    # Mean envy parameter
mu_tau <- 0.7     # Mean inverse temperature
mu_ep <- 0.4      # Mean adaptation rate

# Separate sigmas for each parameter
sigma_alpha <- 0.1
sigma_tau <- 0.08
sigma_epsilon <- 0.1
```

# Generate subject-level parameters
```{r}
generate_param <- function(mu, sigma, n) {
  # n is total subject N
  z_score <- qnorm(mu) # Step 1: Convert probability to z-score
  random_values <- rnorm(n, mean = z_score, sd = sigma) # Step 2: Generate random normal values
  probabilities <- pnorm(random_values)  # Step 3: Convert back to probability scale (0-1)
  return(probabilities)
}

# Generate parameters for each subject
alpha <- generate_param(mu_alpha, sigma_alpha, N)
tau <- generate_param(mu_tau, sigma_tau, N)
epsilon <- generate_param(mu_ep, sigma_epsilon, N)

# Initialize data frame
sim_data <- data.frame()

# Generate data for each subject
for (i in 1:N) {
  f <- 10.0  # Initial norm/initial prediction
  
  for (t in 1:T_max) {
    offer <- sample(1:10, 1) # Generate a random offer between 1-10
    PE <- offer - f # Calculate prediction error
    
    util <- offer - alpha[i] * max(f - offer, 0) # Calculate utility
    p_accept <- 1/(1 + exp(-util * tau[i])) # Calculate acceptance probability
    
    decision <- rbinom(1, 1, p_accept)  # Generate decision
    
    f <- f + epsilon[i] * PE # Update norm based on RL
    
    sim_data <- rbind(sim_data, 
                      data.frame(subject = sprintf("sub-%d", i),
                               trial = t,
                               offer = offer,
                               accept = decision))
  }
}
```

# Convert to format needed for Stan
```{r}
offers <- matrix(0, nrow = N, ncol = T_max)
accepts <- matrix(0, nrow = N, ncol = T_max)
Tsubj <- rep(T_max, N)

for (i in 1:N) {
  subj_data <- subset(sim_data, subject == sprintf("sub-%d", i))
  offers[i, 1:T_max] <- subj_data$offer
  accepts[i, 1:T_max] <- subj_data$accept
}

# Create list for Stan
stan_data <- list(
  N = N, # total subs, double
  T_max = T_max, # maximum trials per sub, double
  Tsubj = Tsubj, # vector of trials per sub
  offer = offers,
  accept = accepts
)
```

# test stan
## check stan syntax
```{r}
stan_code_dir = paste(file_dir, "ug_delta_m1.stan", sep = "/")
mod <- cmdstan_model(
  stan_file = stan_code_dir,
  compile = FALSE  # Don't compile, just check syntax
)

# Basic syntax check
mod$check_syntax(pedantic = TRUE)
```

## fit stan model
```{r}
# Compile and fit Stan model
simu_fit <- stan(
  file = stan_code_dir,    # Replace with your Stan model file name
  data = stan_data,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  cores = 4,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)
```


```{r}
# Extract posterior samples
posterior <- extract(simu_fit)

# Parameter Recovery Analysis
## Compare true vs estimated group-level parameters
true_params <- c(mu_alpha, mu_tau, mu_ep)

print(true_params)

estimates_mean <- c(
  mean(posterior$mu_alpha),
  mean(posterior$mu_tau),
  mean(posterior$mu_ep)
)

print(estimates_mean)

estimates_median <- c(
  median(posterior$mu_alpha),
  median(posterior$mu_tau),
  median(posterior$mu_ep)
)

print(estimates_median)
```


```{r}
# Create parameter recovery plot
param_recovery <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Alpha", "Tau", "Epsilon"),
  True = true_params,
  Estimated = estimated_params,
  Lower_CI = c(
    quantile(posterior$mu_alpha, 0.025),
    quantile(posterior$mu_tau, 0.025),
    quantile(posterior$mu_ep, 0.025)
  ),
  Upper_CI = c(
    quantile(posterior$mu_alpha, 0.975),
    quantile(posterior$mu_tau, 0.975),
    quantile(posterior$mu_ep, 0.975)
  )
)

# Plot parameter recovery
ggplot(param_recovery, aes(x = True, y = Estimated)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower_CI, ymax = Upper_CI)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~Parameter) +
  labs(title = "Parameter Recovery",
       x = "True Value",
       y = "Estimated Value")
```


```{r}
# Diagnostic plots
## Trace plots
mcmc_trace(simu_fit, pars = c("mu_alpha", "mu_tau", "mu_ep"))

## Density plots
mcmc_dens_overlay(simu_fit, pars = c("mu_alpha", "mu_tau", "mu_ep"))

# Print summary statistics
print(summary(simu_fit, pars = c("mu_alpha", "mu_tau", "mu_ep", 
                           "sigma[1]", "sigma[2]", "sigma[3]"))$summary)

# R-hat values
rhat <- rhat(simu_fit)
print(rhat[grep("mu_|sigma", names(rhat))])

# Effective sample sizes
neff <- neff_ratio(simu_fit)
print(neff[grep("mu_|sigma", names(neff))])

# Individual-level parameter recovery
## Extract true individual parameters
true_indiv <- data.frame(
  Subject = 1:N,
  True_Alpha = alpha,
  True_Tau = tau,
  True_Epsilon = epsilon
)

## Extract estimated individual parameters
est_indiv <- data.frame(
  Subject = 1:N,
  Est_Alpha = colMeans(posterior$alpha),
  Est_Tau = colMeans(posterior$tau),
  Est_Epsilon = colMeans(posterior$ep)
)

## Plot individual-level recovery
indiv_recovery <- merge(true_indiv, est_indiv)

# Create correlation plots for individual parameters
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(indiv_recovery$True_Alpha, indiv_recovery$Est_Alpha,
     main = "Individual Alpha Recovery",
     xlab = "True Alpha", ylab = "Estimated Alpha")
abline(0, 1, lty = 2)

plot(indiv_recovery$True_Tau, indiv_recovery$Est_Tau,
     main = "Individual Tau Recovery",
     xlab = "True Tau", ylab = "Estimated Tau")
abline(0, 1, lty = 2)

plot(indiv_recovery$True_Epsilon, indiv_recovery$Est_Epsilon,
     main = "Individual Epsilon Recovery",
     xlab = "True Epsilon", ylab = "Estimated Epsilon")
abline(0, 1, lty = 2)

# Calculate correlations between true and estimated parameters
correlations <- c(
  Alpha = cor(indiv_recovery$True_Alpha, indiv_recovery$Est_Alpha),
  Tau = cor(indiv_recovery$True_Tau, indiv_recovery$Est_Tau),
  Epsilon = cor(indiv_recovery$True_Epsilon, indiv_recovery$Est_Epsilon)
)

print("Correlations between true and estimated parameters:")
print(correlations)

```
